entities.summary: Bandung Geological Museum is a Museum in Bandung, Indonesia. The Museum was built in 1928 and inaugurated with the name "Geologische Museum" on 16 May, 1929. In 1998, the museum was renovated with funding from Japan International Cooperation Agency. After the renovation was completed, the Museum was reopened and inaugurated by the Vice President of Indonesia, Megawati Soekarnoputri on August 23, 2000.
